name: amoo-live
description: Claude Code only, experimental: a live device pane with per-session progress, pause/resume/retry controls, recording health, artifacts and failed-assertion toasts. Requires the amoo CLI and MCP server.

amooPath.title: amoo executable
amooPath.description: Name or absolute path of the amoo CLI that runs `amoo device stream` for the mirror.

fps.title: Mirror frames per second
fps.description: Frames per second to aim for, 0.1 to 30. Capture speed caps it at about 2 on simulators and about 1 on physical iOS devices.
